consumer: The pickup path's carry-eligibility check (e.g. Character::can_pickWeight / weight_capacity()-vs-weight gate) asking 'does adding this specific item's weight exceed the avatar's remaining carry weight?'
scope: this-item's weight vs the avatar's remaining carry-weight capacity at pickup time (engine's own can-carry predicate, including capacity modifiers), not raw avatar status scalars
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar(scalars) — emits hp/stamina/moves/pain/thirst/fatigue/stored_kcal/kcal_percent getters; it exposes NONE of weight, weight_capacity, or any carry-eligibility predicate, so it cannot answer the goal
divergence: An avatar already overloaded (current weight already at/above weight_capacity): the engine's pickup predicate returns 'won't fit', but the exposed scalars reveal no weight info at all, and even a raw weight-vs-capacity re-derivation would miss engine capacity modifiers the real can-carry call applies
